content:
On 23 April, BUILT CoLAB organised a session on the fundamental concepts of the BIM methodology for the members of the Agenda Sustainable Stone by Portugal consortium, as part of activity A6.1 – Sustainable Digital Hub for the Local Economy (Porto Mós), in which it participates.

The session took place in a hybrid format and was attended by more than 17 consortium members, divided between online and face-to-face formats at the Mineral Resources Science Centre in Porto de Mós. Over the course of 6 hours, this initiative allowed for the sharing of knowledge and debate on the importance of BIM in the Natural Stone sector.

We would like to thank the Municipality of Porto de Mós and the Mineral Resources Cluster for their support in realising this important milestone for the Sustainable Stone by Portugal Agenda.
